Le module calcule un écart entre une cib.en: The module computes a gap between a target and a declaration; it establishes no competency. Confirm through a role-play, a practical exercise or a conversation with the manager before turning it into an HR expectation.

Le niveau de départ est DÉCLARÉ, pas mes.en: The starting level is DECLARED, not measured

Les niveaux # et # décrivent un rôle — t.en: Levels # and # describe a role — passing on, designing. A sensitive sector and a technical department raise the requirement placed on a person; they do not give them that role. The screen says, family by family, what it capped for that reason.

L’article # du règlement (UE) #/# impose.en: Article # of Regulation (EU) #/# requires measures to be taken to ensure a sufficient level of AI literacy; it writes no scale. The six levels and the per-role targets are a reading, to be endorsed by the business lines, the managers and IT.
